observed: The original CLI PowerShell supervisor created a suspended child before AssignProcessToJobObject. A deterministic gate in the real old source proves helper death leaves that child alive outside the Job; exact kernel creation FILETIME cleanup reclaims it without process-name killing.

STARTUPINFOEX and PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST now establish membership in CreateProcess itself. IsProcessInJob verifies it before Resume; unsupported Job-list creation fails closed without an Assign fallback.

A real creator kernel handle, creation-time check and watchdog cover creator death before creation, after creation and while descendants run. Helper death after atomic creation/resume closes the only Job handle and kills the owned tree. Abrupt paths do not invent graceful stopped evidence.

Existing anonymous pipes, base64 CLI-output framing, native control channel, EOF/deadline/exit semantics, ActiveProcesses stop evidence and named-pipe peer checks remain. Console JSON is UTF-8 before the first request; exact Unicode/empty/quote/newline/backslash argv and child exit codes pass.

limitations: This is cooperative Windows process containment, not a separate account, AppContainer, filesystem/network isolation boundary or complete model-facing command backend.
No real model inference, response identity, entitlement, usage or billing was tested. The installed probe uses a synthetic configured model and refuses provider HTTP at a local sink.
The creator pre-open timestamp check assumes a trusted host clock; after opening, the original kernel handle supplies lifetime identity.
Existing ReadLine-based bootstrap/relay input is not reclassified as a streaming hard cap; that separate framing concern is not closed by this Job fix.

Full remote CLI locations, twelve-tool/PTY/write facades, fs_write leaf/parent pinning, workspace permissions/config generations, migration/activation, production sleep/desktop/UI/installer and release acceptance remain open.
